scope: Documentation-level assessment of five selected external sources, not an exhaustive search or validation of underlying labels.

sources.name: RTP-LX
sources.reported_evidence: Native-speaker transcreation and annotation; Romanian and Ukrainian are listed. Romanian is marked as lacking completions and culturally specific prompts. Eight toxicity-related dimensions use ordinal annotations.
sources.task_fit: No established mapping to RoGuard response boundary/privacy/pressure/unsupported classes or its user-support concern task. A toxicity label cannot be silently substituted.
sources.rights_status: Repository LICENSE references MIT plus third-party NOTICE; older dataset metadata also lists noncommercial terms. Component-specific rights have not been resolved for proposed reuse.
sources.potential_use: Possible separately scoped auxiliary evaluation after task and component-rights review; no corpus imported.

sources.name: RoSafetyBench
sources.reported_evidence: 953 Romanian-first prompts, including805 generated expansions. The card says the independent native-speaker audit is unfinished and identifies malformed text, category/expected-behavior issues and unreliable factual references.
sources.task_fit: Prompt refusal, bias and factual-response evaluation differs from RoGuard five-category behavior and concern classification.
sources.potential_use: External synthetic research source only after an appropriate separate design and quality checks.

sources.name: Ukrainian Nemotron adaptation
sources.reported_evidence: 32782 TRAIN,1965 validation and2313 TEST rows. Ukrainian localization uses automated translation/fluency and ensemble label-consistency checks. The inspected card does not establish independent native-human verification of this localized release.
sources.task_fit: Broad safe/unsafe labels and Nemotron categories differ from RoGuard. Row-level category tags and repeated upstream IDs require explicit handling; labels must not be mapped mechanically to response classes.
sources.potential_use: Potential external synthetic TRAIN diversity after a registered role-specific annotation/mapping and deduplication plan. No current training use.

sources.name: NVIDIA Nemotron Safety Guard v3
sources.reported_evidence: Twelve declared languages exclude Romanian and Ukrainian. The card describes translated/adapted synthetic data and mixed human/model label provenance.
sources.task_fit: Does not directly supply either target-language qualification population. Broad moderation labels differ from RoGuard tasks.
sources.potential_use: Upstream provenance reference; no current corpus use.

sources.name: Hasan Kursun multilingual safety classification
sources.reported_evidence: Includes Romanian and Ukrainian via NLLB machine translation. Three labels represent safe, needs-review and unsafe; target-language independent human annotation is not established by the inspected card.
sources.task_fit: Neither translated labels nor the three-way moderation taxonomy establish RoGuard gold labels.
sources.potential_use: No import; the card declares CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, which also requires review before any proposed public artifact reuse.
